authorization: Root approved limited deterministic reanalysis of existing 200 designs; no Monte Carlo or new DGPs.
all_instances: All IDs 0 through 199, without screening; p=6,n=12 from archived inputs.
model: Nonadaptive linear-Gaussian fixed designs; sigma is observation standard deviation, variance=sigma squared. No new Y or beta generated.
target_greedy: Choose largest (t transpose V x)^2 / (sigma squared + x transpose V x); rank-one update V; deterministic smallest candidate ID breaks exact ties.
logdet_greedy: Choose largest .5 log(1+x transpose V x/sigma squared); same tie convention and covariance update.
exhaustive: Enumerate all combinations at each budget:12,66,495; choose minimum target variance or maximum logdet; lexicographic first breaks exact ties.
target_radius: 1.96 sqrt(t transpose V t), matching archived Gaussian target radius. No claim of a U/L/H certificate, sharp PI width, or non-Gaussian confidence interval.
primary: Budget4 target-greedy radius divided by exhaustive target-optimal radius; all200 designs.
secondary: maximum condition number across every feasible subset at the same budget

condition_strata.diagnostic: maximum posterior condition number across every feasible subset at a given budget
condition_strata.interpretation: Exploratory descriptive strata, not a tested causal effect or theorem condition cutoff.

target_relevance: Prior-standardized absolute correlation |t transpose P x|/sqrt((t transpose P t)(x transpose P x)); save menu max and correlation of first greedy choice. Descriptive only.
checks: Saved covariance rank-one updates versus independent direct linear solves
Greedy choice scores using independently rebuilt covariances
Archived B4 values reproduce within numerical tolerance
No outcomes sampled and no source archive writes
runtime_basis: Historical ~.016seconds/design for B4;200*(12+66+495) small6x6 subset inversions plus greedy scores. CPU; no GPU. Independent audit/report time separate.
